name: Thailand
tagline: Limestone karsts, long-tail boats and night markets, four hours from Delhi.
flightFromIndia: 4 h from Delhi or Mumbai, 3 h 30 m from Kolkata

visa.type: Visa-free entry + Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC)
visa.stay: 30 days
visa.govFee: Free
visa.processing: TDAC opens 3 days before arrival

name: Sri Lanka
tagline: Rock fortresses, tea hills and the slowest, prettiest train ride in Asia.
flightFromIndia: 1 h 15 m from Chennai, 1 h from Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram

visa.type: Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA)
visa.stay: 30 days, double entry
visa.govFee: Free for Indian tourists
visa.processing: Usually within 1–3 days

name: Vietnam
tagline: Karst bays, lantern towns and the best ₹150 bowl of noodles you will ever eat.
flightFromIndia: 4 h direct from Delhi or Mumbai to Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City

visa.type: e-Visa
visa.stay: Up to 90 days
visa.govFee: US$25 single entry, US$50 multiple entry
visa.processing: 3–5 working days

name: Iceland
tagline: Waterfalls, black-sand beaches and glaciers, on one road around an island.
flightFromIndia: No direct flights: about 14–18 h via a European hub

visa.type: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) via VFS Global
visa.stay: Up to 90 days in any 180
visa.govFee: €90 visa fee + VFS service charge
visa.processing: About 15 calendar days

name: Singapore
tagline: A clean, compact city-state of gardens, hawker food and theme parks, five hours from India.
flightFromIndia: About 4 h 30 m from Chennai, 5 h 30 m from Delhi or Mumbai

visa.type: Visa required (via an authorised agent) + SG Arrival Card
visa.stay: Set by the visit pass issued at the checkpoint
visa.govFee: Not stated by ICA; set by the visa agent
visa.processing: Ask the agent; SG Arrival Card within 3 days before arrival

name: Bhutan
tagline: A Himalayan kingdom of dzongs and cliffside monasteries that Indians can enter without a visa.
flightFromIndia: About 45 min to 2 h from Bagdogra, Kolkata, Guwahati or Delhi to Paro

visa.type: No visa; entry permit with Indian passport or voter ID, plus the Sustainable Development Fee
visa.stay: Set by the permit (the official FAQ gives up to 90 days for visas)
visa.govFee: SDF Nu 1,200 (₹1,200) per adult per night; ₹600 for ages 6–11; free under 6
visa.processing: Apply online before travel, or at the point of entry (may involve a wait)

name: Malaysia
tagline: Island beaches, rainforest and a skyline of twin towers, visa-free for Indians until the end of 2026.
flightFromIndia: About 4 h from Chennai, 5 h 30 m from Delhi or Mumbai

visa.type: Visa waiver for Indian passport holders until 31 Dec 2026, plus the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC)
visa.stay: Up to 30 days
visa.govFee: No visa fee under the waiver; the MDAC is free
visa.processing: No application; submit the MDAC 3 days before arrival

name: Maldives
tagline: Turquoise lagoons and local-island guesthouses, with a free visa on arrival and a short online declaration.
currency: Maldivian rufiyaa (MVR); US dollars are widely used
flightFromIndia: About 2 h from Thiruvananthapuram or Kochi, 3 to 4 h 30 m from Bengaluru, Mumbai or Delhi

visa.type: Tourist visa issued on arrival, plus the online Traveller Declaration (IMUGA)
visa.stay: 30 days according to Maldives mission pages; the immigration page we fetched does not state a length
visa.govFee: Free; the Traveller Declaration is also free
visa.processing: No application; submit the Traveller Declaration online, up to 96 hours before arrival

name: Georgia
tagline: Caucasus peaks, wine villages and a walkable old Tbilisi, reached with a short online e-visa.
flightFromIndia: Usually one stop; about 7 to 10 h in total from Delhi or Mumbai

visa.type: e-Visa for Indian passport holders, applied for online
visa.stay: Up to 30 days for a single-entry short-term visa under Georgian law; you request the days on the application
visa.govFee: US$20 plus a 2% service fee; the application page also lists a US$15 identity-verification fee
visa.processing: A decision takes at least 5 working days according to the portal FAQ

name: United Kingdom
tagline: London landmarks and Edinburgh's old town, reached with a Standard Visitor visa applied for in advance.
flightFromIndia: About 9 to 10 h non-stop from Delhi or Mumbai to London

visa.type: Standard Visitor visa, applied for before travel (India is on the UK visa national list)
visa.stay: Usually up to 6 months
visa.govFee: £135 for a visa of up to 6 months; long-term visas are £506 (2 years), £903 (5 years) and £1,128 (10 years)
visa.processing: Usually a decision within 3 weeks; apply no earlier than 3 months before travel

name: Hong Kong
tagline: A skyscraper harbour, island hikes and dim sum, about six hours from Delhi or Mumbai.
flightFromIndia: About 5 h 30 m non-stop from Delhi, 6 h from Mumbai

visa.type: Visa-free visit after a free online Pre-arrival Registration (PAR)
visa.stay: Up to 14 days per visit
visa.govFee: Free
visa.processing: Instant online; the registration lasts 6 months

name: Nepal
tagline: Temples in Kathmandu and lakeside Himalayan views in Pokhara, a short flight from Delhi with no visa to apply for.
flightFromIndia: About 1 h 45 m non-stop from Delhi; also direct from Mumbai, Kolkata and other cities

visa.type: No visa for Indian citizens; by air you need a valid passport or an original Voter ID
visa.stay: Not stated on the Indian Embassy page; we could not reach Nepal's immigration site
visa.govFee: None
visa.processing: None; documents are checked at the airline counter and at immigration

name: Turkey
tagline: Istanbul's domes and bazaars, then balloons over the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia.
currency: Turkish lira (TRY); check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: About 6 h non-stop from Delhi or Mumbai to Istanbul

visa.type: Visa needed; e-Visa only with a valid Schengen, US, UK or Ireland visa or residence permit, otherwise a sticker visa
visa.stay: e-Visa: single entry, one month (per the Turkish foreign ministry)
visa.govFee: Not stated on the ministry or embassy pages we could read; shown on evisa.gov.tr
visa.processing: e-Visa is online; the sticker visa goes through the embassy or consulate

name: Indonesia
tagline: Bali's rice terraces, temples and cliff-top beaches, with a visa on arrival for Indian passport holders.
flightFromIndia: About 6 h non-stop from Mumbai or Bengaluru to Bali; most other cities connect via Singapore or Kuala Lumpur

visa.type: Visa on arrival for Indian passport holders (India is on the immigration list), plus the free All Indonesia arrival card
visa.stay: 30 days, extendable once by 30 days
visa.govFee: IDR 500,000 (extension also IDR 500,000); a rise to IDR 750,000 online / IDR 1,000,000 on arrival was proposed in August 2026 but we found no start date
visa.processing: Granted at the airport on arrival; an e-VOA can be bought online in advance at evisa.imigrasi.go.id

name: New Zealand
tagline: Alpine lakes, fiords and empty roads on the South Island, reached with a visitor visa applied for online.
currency: New Zealand dollar (NZD); check the day's rate
timezone: IST + 6:30 (IST + 7:30 in NZ daylight time, late September to early April)
flightFromIndia: No non-stop from India; usually one stop, for example via Singapore, Kuala Lumpur or Sydney

visa.type: Visitor visa, applied for online before travel; Indian applicants have their own checklist
visa.stay: Up to 6 or 9 months depending on the visa; the visitor visa page says a maximum of 9 months in an 18-month period
visa.govFee: From NZD 441 per the visitor visa page, which doesn't say whether the visitor levy is included; any application centre charge is separate
visa.processing: The page says 80% of applications are decided within 2 weeks

name: Japan
tagline: Bullet trains, temples and cherry blossom between Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka, on a visa you file in advance.
currency: Japanese yen (JPY), roughly ₹0.60 per yen; check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: Roughly 8 to 9 h non-stop from Delhi to Tokyo; most other Indian cities connect via Southeast or East Asia

visa.type: Temporary visitor (tourist) visa, applied for in advance through a Japan Visa Application Centre run by VFS Global
visa.stay: Up to 90 days under the tourist visa; the consulate sets the length granted
visa.govFee: INR 500 for single or multiple entry (effective 1 April 2026), plus a VFS service charge of INR 800
visa.processing: Minimum 3 working days after submission, an indicative figure; you can apply up to 89 days before travel

name: United Arab Emirates
tagline: Skyscrapers, desert dunes and a white marble mosque, three and a half hours from Mumbai or Delhi.
currency: UAE dirham (AED), roughly ₹24; check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: About 3 h 15 m from Mumbai, 3 h 30 m from Delhi, 3 h 30 m to 4 h from Kerala and the south

visa.type: Visa required in advance (visit visa via GDRFA Dubai, ICP, an airline or an agent); visa on arrival only for Indians holding a US, UK or EU visa or permit
visa.stay: 30 or 60 days on a single-entry tourist visa; 14 days on the visa on arrival, extendable once
visa.govFee: AED 200 (30 days) or AED 300 (60 days) plus 5% VAT on the GDRFA Dubai single-entry page; agents and airlines add their own charges
visa.processing: GDRFA Dubai lists 48 hours as the expected completion time

name: Switzerland
tagline: Alpine peaks, lake towns and mountain railways, reached with a Schengen visa applied for through VFS.
currency: Swiss franc (CHF), roughly ₹115–120; check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: About 8 to 9 h non-stop from Delhi or Mumbai to Zurich; one-stop routes from other cities

visa.type: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), lodged through VFS Global and decided by the Swiss Embassy in New Delhi
visa.stay: Up to 90 days in any 180
visa.govFee: €90 for adults (€45 for ages 6–12, free under 6) plus a VFS service charge of INR 2,690
visa.processing: Usually 15 calendar days; apply at most 180 days and at least 15 days before travel

name: Canada
tagline: Turquoise lakes, glaciers and the Rockies' scenic highways, reached with a visitor visa applied for online.
currency: Canadian dollar (CAD), roughly ₹63; check the day's rate
timezone: Alberta: IST − 11:30 (IST − 12:30 in winter); Ontario: IST − 9:30 (IST − 10:30 in winter)
flightFromIndia: No non-stop to Calgary; one stop from Delhi or Mumbai, about 20 to 24 hours door to door

visa.type: Visitor visa (temporary resident visa) applied for online through the IRCC portal, with biometrics; Indian citizens are not eligible for the eTA
visa.stay: The border officer sets the stay on arrival; the visa itself can be valid up to 10 years or until your passport or biometrics expire
visa.govFee: CAD 100 visa fee plus CAD 85 biometrics fee per person (about ₹11,700 in total)
visa.processing: Varies by month; IRCC publishes it in a processing-times tool for India, so apply at least 3 months before travel

name: Philippines
tagline: Limestone lagoons, island-hopping boats and white-sand coves, visa-free for Indians for up to 14 days.
currency: Philippine peso (PHP), roughly ₹1.5; check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: About 6 h 45 m to 7 h 15 m non-stop from Delhi on Air India; one-stop routes from other cities

visa.type: Visa-free entry for Indian passport holders (tourism), plus the free online eTravel registration
visa.stay: 14 days, non-extendable; 30 days with a valid US, Japanese, Australian, Canadian, Schengen, Singapore or UK visa or residence permit
visa.govFee: No visa fee; eTravel is free
visa.processing: No application; register on eTravel at least 72 hours before arrival

name: Egypt
tagline: Pyramids at dawn, temples on the Nile and a cruise between Luxor and Aswan.
currency: Egyptian pound (EGP); check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: About 5 h 30 m non-stop from Mumbai, otherwise 1 stop via the Gulf or Istanbul

visa.type: e-Visa (tourist), applied for on the Egypt e-Visa Portal
visa.stay: Not stated on the portal pages we could read; check your issued visa
visa.govFee: US$30 single entry, US$65 multiple entry (portal FAQ)
visa.processing: The portal asks you to apply at least 7 days before departure

name: Italy
tagline: Ancient Rome, Renaissance Florence and the canals of Venice, linked by fast trains.
currency: Euro (EUR), roughly ₹95–105; check the day's rate
flightFromIndia: About 9 h non-stop from Delhi to Rome; one-stop routes from other cities

visa.type: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), lodged through VFS Global and decided by the Italian Embassy in New Delhi or a consulate
visa.stay: Up to 90 days in any 180
visa.govFee: €90 for adults (€45 for ages 6–11, free under 6) plus a VFS service charge
visa.processing: Decisions on C visas are generally reached within 15 calendar days; apply no earlier than six months before travel
